disease_mutation_with_articles_and_predi.name: disease_mutation_with_articles_and_predictions

biomarker_core.name: biomarker_core
biomarker_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.id AS id,
  -- normalize gene_symbol: trim and nullify empty strings
  NULLIF(trim(b.gene_symbol), '') AS gene_symbol,
  -- biomarker_description: prefer biomarker.biomarker_description, fall back to biomarker.biomarker_id,
  -- normalize empty strings to NULL
  NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(b.biomarker_description, b.biomarker_id)), '') AS biomarker_description,
  -- biomarker_type exposed for filtering; normalize empty strings to NULL
  NULLIF(trim(be.biomarker_type), '') AS biomarker_type,
  -- test_is_a_panel is boolean already; keep as-is
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel
FROM biomarker b
LEFT JOIN biomarker_edrn be
  ON be.id = b.id
biomarker_core.description: Canonical projection of the biomarker table exposing key identifiers, gene symbol, descriptive text, type and panel flag. Normalizes nullable text and ensures types are exposed for downstream filtering.

  (be.id IS NOT NULL) AS has_edrn_entry,
  (bf.id IS NOT NULL) AS has_fda_entry
FROM biomarker b
LEFT JOIN biomarker_edrn be
  ON be.id = b.id
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda bf
  ON bf.id = b.id
biomarker_to_edrn_fda_presence.description: Denormalized presence flags linking biomarkers to EDRN and FDA records. One row per biomarker.id showing whether matching entries exist in biomarker_edrn and biomarker_fda (by id). Useful for filtering biomarkers that are associated with cancer-focused registries or approvals.

biomarker_core_projection.name: biomarker_core_projection
biomarker_core_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- stable primary id for the biomarker row: prefer biomarker.id, else biomarker_edrn.id
  COALESCE(b.id, be.id) AS id,

  -- external/secondary biomarker identifier from biomarker table (lifted literal: none)
  b.biomarker_id AS biomarker_id,

  -- gene symbol from biomarker (common descriptive field)
  b.gene_symbol AS gene_symbol,

  -- descriptive fields from biomarker_edrn when available (lifted literals: none)
  be.biomarker_title AS biomarker_title,
  be.biomarker_type AS biomarker_type,
  be.qa_state AS qa_state,
  be.phase AS phase,
  be.uberon_anatomical_id AS uberon_anatomical_id,

  -- boolean flag from biomarker indicating panel status
  b.test_is_a_panel AS test_is_a_panel

FROM
  biomarker b
  FULL JOIN biomarker_edrn be
    ON b.id = be.id
biomarker_core_projection.description: Canonical projection of biomarker-related identifying and descriptive fields across biomarker and biomarker_edrn where available; exposes stable ids and common descriptive dims for filtering and grouping.

biomarker_edrn_type_normalized.name: biomarker_edrn_type_normalized
biomarker_edrn_type_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  biomarker_title,
  -- canonicalize biomarker_type: trim whitespace, lower-case, map common variants to normalized categories
  -- lift literal mappings out: (see mapping rules below in metadata)
  CASE
    WHEN biomarker_type IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- trim surrounding whitespace and convert to lower-case for pattern matching
      (
        CASE
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('protein', 'protein biomarker', 'protein-coding') THEN 'protein'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('rna', 'mrna', 'micro rna', 'mirna', 'micro-rna', 'micro_rna') THEN 'rna'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('dna', 'genomic', 'genetic', 'genomic alteration') THEN 'dna'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('metabolite', 'metabolic') THEN 'metabolite'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('imaging', 'radiology', 'radiographic') THEN 'imaging'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('lipid', 'lipid marker') THEN 'lipid'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('epigenetic', 'methylation') THEN 'epigenetic'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('cellular', 'cell-based') THEN 'cellular'
          WHEN lower(trim(biomarker_type)) IN ('unknown', 'other', 'n/a', '') THEN 'other'
          ELSE lower(trim(biomarker_type))
        END
      )
  END AS biomarker_type_normalized,
  qa_state,
  uberon_anatomical_id,
  phase
FROM biomarker_edrn
biomarker_edrn_type_normalized.description: Normalized/cleaned projection of biomarker_edrn that canonicalizes biomarker_type and trims whitespace to support consistent filtering and grouping.

biomarker_edrn_by_anatomy.name: biomarker_edrn_by_anatomy

biomarker_edrn_by_anatomy.description: Counts of biomarker_edrn records per uberon_anatomical_id and biomarker_type to support aggregated exploration (keeps row-level count measure but grouped per anatomy+type).

biomarker_edrn_type_title_normalized.name: biomarker_edrn_type_title_normalized
biomarker_edrn_type_title_normalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  -- canonicalized title: trim whitespace; reduce any internal runs of whitespace to single space; preserve case
  NULLIF(regexp_replace(trim(biomarker_title), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), '') AS biomarker_title,
  -- canonicalized type: trim and collapse whitespace, uppercase for normalization; NULL if empty after trim
  NULLIF(upper(regexp_replace(trim(biomarker_type), '\s+', ' ', 'g')), '') AS biomarker_type
FROM
  biomarker_edrn
biomarker_edrn_type_title_normalized.description: Normalized projection of biomarker_edrn focusing on canonicalized title and type fields; trims NULLs and exposes the title/type pair for downstream matching and text-matching queries.

LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test_trial tt
  ON t.test_trade_name = tt.test_trade_name
  AND t.test_submission = tt.test_submission
LEFT JOIN biomarker_fda_test_use fu
  ON t.test_trade_name = fu.test_trade_name
  AND t.test_submission = fu.test_submission
fda_test_trial_and_use_summary.description: Denormalized FDA test rows joined to their trial ids and approved/actual use records; one row per (test_trade_name, test_submission, test_trial_id, id) to support queries that need combined FDA test metadata and associated trial/use entries.

differential_expression_with_disease.name: differential_expression_with_disease
differential_expression_with_disease.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.pvalue                                                   AS pvalue,
  d.gene_symbol                                               AS gene_symbol,
  d.doid                                                      AS doid,
  disease.id                                                   AS "disease.id",
  disease.name                                                 AS "disease.name",
  d.log2fc                                                    AS log2fc,
  d.adjpvalue                                                 AS adjpvalue
FROM
  differential_expression d
LEFT JOIN
  disease
ON
  d.doid = disease.id
differential_expression_with_disease.description: Denormalized differential expression rows joined to disease metadata so queries can filter by disease name or id without rejoining tables.

differential_expression_stats_per_diseas.name: differential_expression_stats_per_disease
differential_expression_stats_per_diseas.body_sql:
SELECT
  doid,
  count(*) AS n_records,
  min(pvalue) AS pvalue_min,
  max(pvalue) AS pvalue_max,
  avg(pvalue) AS pvalue_mean,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pvalue) AS pvalue_median,
  min(adjpvalue) AS adjpvalue_min
FROM
  differential_expression
GROUP BY
  doid
differential_expression_stats_per_diseas.description: Aggregate statistical summaries of differential expression grouped by disease (doid) to support quick per-disease overviews (counts and basic p-value summaries).

disease_mutation_row_level_39.name: disease_mutation_row_level_39
disease_mutation_row_level_39.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id                              AS "disease_mutation.id",
  dm.chromosome_id                   AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_id",
  dm.chromosome_pos                  AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_pos",
  dm.doid                            AS "disease_mutation.doid"
FROM
  disease_mutation dm
disease_mutation_row_level_39.description: Row-level disease mutation records exposing genomic location and disease linkage for cohort filtering and joins.

disease_basic.name: disease_basic
disease_basic.body_sql:
SELECT
  d.id AS "disease.id",
  d.name AS "disease.name",
  lower(d.name) AS lower_name
FROM
  disease d
disease_basic.description: Normalized disease table exposing canonical disease id and lowercased name for case-insensitive matching.

disease_mutation_with_disease_41.name: disease_mutation_with_disease_41
disease_mutation_with_disease_41.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id AS "disease_mutation.id",
  dm.chromosome_id AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_id",
  dm.chromosome_pos AS "disease_mutation.chromosome_pos",

FROM disease_mutation dm
LEFT JOIN disease d

disease_mutation_with_disease_41.description: Denormalized disease_mutation rows joined to disease to enable filtering mutations by disease attributes.

disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping.name: disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping
disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  dm.id,
  dm.chromosome_id,
  dm.chromosome_pos,
  dm.ref_nt,
  dm.alt_nt,
  dm.ensembl_transcript_id,
  dm.cds_pos,
  dm.peptide_pos,
  dm.aa_pos_uniprotkb,
  dm.ref_aa,
  dm.alt_aa,
  dm.mutation_freq,
  dm.data_source,
  dm.doid,
  mpm.peptide_id,
  mpm.uniprotkb_ac,
  muc.uniprotkb_canonical_ac
FROM disease_mutation dm
LEFT JOIN map_protein_disease_mutation mpm
  ON dm.ensembl_transcript_id = mpm.ensembl_transcript_id
LEFT JOIN map_uniprot_canonical_id muc
  ON mpm.uniprotkb_ac = muc.uniprotkb_ac
disease_mutation_with_transcript_mapping.description: Denormalized view joining disease_mutation to transcript/protein mapping (map_protein_disease_mutation) and canonical UniProt id (map_uniprot_canonical_id) to provide protein identifiers alongside mutation rows.

disease_mutation_counts_by_amino_acid.name: disease_mutation_counts_by_amino_acid
disease_mutation_counts_by_amino_acid.body_sql:

WHERE

fda_tests_row_level.name: fda_tests_row_level
fda_tests_row_level.body_sql:

fda_test_manufacturer_summary.name: fda_test_manufacturer_summary
fda_test_manufacturer_summary.body_sql:

  COUNT(DISTINCT test_submission) AS distinct_test_count,
  MIN(test_number_genes) AS min_test_number_genes,
  MAX(test_number_genes) AS max_test_number_genes,
  AVG(test_number_genes::numeric) AS avg_test_number_genes
FROM
  fda_tests_rowlevel

fda_test_manufacturer_summary.description: Aggregated counts of FDA tests per test_manufacturer and other categorical attributes. One row per manufacturer summarizing number of distinct tests and basic stats.

fda_test_key_attributes.name: fda_test_key_attributes
fda_test_key_attributes.body_sql:
SELECT
  f.test_trade_name,
  f.test_submission,
  f.test_manufacturer,
  -- canonicalized manufacturer: lower-case trimmed, NULL if empty after trim
  NULLIF(trim(lower(f.test_manufacturer)), '') AS test_manufacturer_normalized,
  -- normalize test_number_genes to integer: if null then null; if numeric already keep integer cast; if non-integer numeric, round to nearest integer
  CASE
    WHEN f.test_number_genes IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(round(f.test_number_genes) AS bigint)
  END AS test_number_genes,
  -- presence flag for test_number_genes: true if non-null and >=0
  (f.test_number_genes IS NOT NULL) AS has_test_number_genes
FROM
  fda_tests_rowlevel f
fda_test_key_attributes.description: Normalized projection of FDA test identifying columns and cleaned attributes (canonicalized manufacturer, normalized counts as integers, presence flags). Useful for uniform filtering and joining.

biomarker_disease_link_candidates.name: biomarker_disease_link_candidates
biomarker_disease_link_candidates.body_sql:
SELECT

Produces rows for biomarker.id and biomarker.biomarker_id together with disease.id as text to allow flexible join strategies (string/ID matching). Each row represents one biomarker (no aggregation).

edrn_biomarker_phase_canonical.name: edrn_biomarker_phase_canonical
edrn_biomarker_phase_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  -- canonicalize phase: trim whitespace, collapse empty-string to NULL,
  -- normalize common variants (case-insensitive) into a small set of canonical labels.
  -- Lifted literals for easy replacement: the mapping keys/outputs are encoded below.
  CASE
    WHEN trim(phase) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE
      -- lower-phase for matching known patterns
      CASE lower(trim(phase))
        WHEN 'preclinical' THEN 'preclinical'
        WHEN 'phase 0' THEN 'phase 0'
        WHEN 'phase 1' THEN 'phase 1'
        WHEN 'phase i' THEN 'phase 1'
        WHEN 'phase 1/2' THEN 'phase 1/2'
        WHEN 'phase 2' THEN 'phase 2'
        WHEN 'phase ii' THEN 'phase 2'
        WHEN 'phase 2/3' THEN 'phase 2/3'
        WHEN 'phase 3' THEN 'phase 3'
        WHEN 'phase iii' THEN 'phase 3'
        WHEN 'approved' THEN 'approved'
        WHEN 'discontinued' THEN 'discontinued'
        WHEN 'unknown' THEN NULL
        ELSE
          -- try to extract leading 'phase' token with optional roman/arabic numeral
          (CASE
             WHEN lower(trim(phase)) ~ '^phase\\s*0\\b' THEN 'phase 0'
             WHEN lower(trim(phase)) ~ '^phase\\s*(i|1)\\b' THEN 'phase 1'
             WHEN lower(trim(phase)) ~ '^phase\\s*(i{2}|2)\\b' THEN 'phase 2'
             WHEN lower(trim(phase)) ~ '^phase\\s*(i{3}|3)\\b' THEN 'phase 3'
             WHEN lower(trim(phase)) ~ '^phase\\s*1\\s*/\\s*2\\b' THEN 'phase 1/2'
             WHEN lower(trim(phase)) ~ '^phase\\s*2\\s*/\\s*3\\b' THEN 'phase 2/3'
             ELSE
               -- preserve trimmed original if nothing matched, but NULL if it was explicitly 'n/a' or similar
               (CASE
                  WHEN lower(trim(phase)) IN ('n/a', 'na', 'not applicable', 'none') THEN NULL
                  ELSE trim(phase)
                END)
           END)
      END
  END AS phase_canonical
FROM biomarker_edrn
edrn_biomarker_phase_canonical.description: Normalized view of biomarker_edrn.phase values with trimming/NULL canonicalization to support consistent phase-valued queries and aggregations. One row per biomarker_edrn.id.

biomarker_edrn_by_anatomy_and_phase.name: biomarker_edrn_by_anatomy_and_phase

disease_differential_expression_join.name: disease_differential_expression_join
disease_differential_expression_join.body_sql:
SELECT

  de.adjpvalue                                     AS adjpvalue,

ON

disease_differential_expression_join.description: Denormalized join of differential_expression rows with disease metadata (id and name). One row per differential_expression measurement (gene + doid) with disease name included to facilitate name-based filters.
